spans.s:
mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Foolish, ignorant.
2 Cold, apathetic, stupid.
3 Perplexed, in doubt.
4 Deceived, erring.
m. (-ढः)
1 An idiot, a fool.
2 A sluggard.
E.
मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त, form irr.

m. (-र्भः)
1 A bad presentation of the child at birth, causing difficult delivery.
2 A dead foetus.
E.
मूढ, and गर्भ the foetus.

m. (-हः)
Infatuation.
E.
मूढ, and ग्राह seizure.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
Insane, bewildered.
E.
मूढ and चेतस् mind.

f. (-ता)
Folly, silliness, ignorance.
E.
मूढ, and तल् aff.; also मूढत्वं.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Foolish, a fool.
E.
मूढ, and आत्मन् self.
